text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the new year, and thus the beginning
of
Nakayama Festa's classic year...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hey, hold up. What are you doing? ...Why're you putting the entry ticket in that box?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You're supposed to aim for one of the
ten
50,000-yen prizes, not one of the
thousand
500-yen prizes.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Geez, you're clueless. What's the point
of using
your luck to win a measly 500
yen?
choice_data_list: でも500円の方が当たる確率が高いし……
choice_data_list_en: But the 500-yen one has higher odds of winning...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We're not even a day in and she's
already
schooling me. This time it's
about how to best use
my New Year
lottery ticket I got at the shopping

district.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since her cleats have begun to wear
down, we
came here to buy some
maintenance supplies
among other
things.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: What of it?
choice_data_list: そういえば減りが早くなってきたな
そういえば減りが早くなってきたね
choice_data_list_en: Come to think of it, it's been running out faster lately.
Come to think of it, it's been running out faster lately, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A typical curt response. But I think the
wear is
evidence of how seriously she's
been training
recently.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Sigh...
choice_data_list: 今年は大きなレースに出るよ
choice_data_list_en: We're entering some big races this year.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Don't look so confident, you hear?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Whatever kinda race I go for hinges on
how well I
do in the Keisei Hai.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...How much are you expecting of me, anyway?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Haha, figured as much.
choice_data_list: ものすごく期待してる
choice_data_list_en: I have really high hopes for you.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
So, are we aiming for a small reward that
anyone
can get their hands on, or a huge
reward that only
a select few can
obtain?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: See?
choice_data_list: デカい報酬に決まってる！
choice_data_list_en: It's gotta be a huge reward!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Swish...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa catches me with my
guard down,
grabbing my lottery ticket
and throwing it into
the 50,000-yen
prize box.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Don't look at me. You just consented to
it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! If you're not happy, we can
settle things
with another wager.
choice_data_list: えー……
choice_data_list_en: Uhh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She cackles with delight. I have to
admit, she got
me good, so...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on. The first person to draw a
great
fortune slip is the winner.
choice_data_list: おみくじで対決だ！
『甘酒チャレンジ』に挑戦しよう！
スクラッチで……上を狙う……ッ！
choice_data_list_en: Let's face off with fortune slips!
Let's take on the "Amazake Challenge"!
Aiming for the top... with a scratcher...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Dang. How many great misfortune slips
have you
drawn already?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Sigh...
choice_data_list: もう、わからない……っ！
choice_data_list_en: I just don't know anymore...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Guess I won't be banking on you when it
comes to
the lottery.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While Nakayama Festa almost
immediately drew
"great fortune," my
situation is just abysmal. I
suppose I can
learn... something... from the
experience.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Wait, what?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh, you really have a habit of noticing
weird
stuff, don't you?
choice_data_list: あっちの店でノボリを見かけて……
choice_data_list_en: I saw a banner at that shop over there, and...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Huh... One's infused with wasabi, and
the other's
a premium brand.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
We have to down them before the smell
hits us.
You ready?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: One... two...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In sync with each other, we both gulp
down the
fermented rice drink from our
cups.
choice_data_list: さん！
choice_data_list_en: Three!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, that hits the spot. Talk about
good quality
rice.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Huh? Trainer? No way... Don't tell me...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Pfft...
choice_data_list: あ　あ　あ　あ　あ　あ　！
choice_data_list_en: A A A A A A H !

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Your face is hilarious! Hahaha,
stop it!
My stomach... Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa seems to be enjoying
herself, so
perhaps I can still count this
as a kind of win.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Not a bad idea!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to seeing this.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
All right, Trainer. Where are the scratch
cards?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I've got you. Let's divide them up and
start
scratching.
choice_data_list: 机の上にある。君も手伝ってくれ……！
机の上にある。貴方も手伝って……！
choice_data_list_en: It's on the desk. Lend me a hand, will you...!
It's on the desk. Please help out too...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Damn it... Nope... This one's a bust...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Trainer, how's it on your end?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
We're not down and out just yet then!
Scratch
awaaay!
choice_data_list: もうダブルチャンスしか残ってない……！
choice_data_list_en: Only the Double Chance is left now...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gulp...
choice_data_list: うおおおおおおお！
えええええええい！
choice_data_list_en: Whoaaaaaaa!
Yaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: And?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: LET'S GOOO!
choice_data_list: あたったあああああああ！
choice_data_list_en: I WONNNNNNNNN!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although the win doesn't recoup the
amount I
spent buying the scratch cards,
the experience
affords an enjoyable New
Year holiday for both
myself and
Nakayama Festa.
